title: Portfolio Risk Management
subtitle: Measure, stress and bound the risk of a book you already run: exposure, VaR, correlation collapse, drawdown rules, the gate stack, tail hedges, margin and the daily risk report, all computed on real data.
what_you_learn: Measure a ten-position long/short book's gross, net, beta-adjusted, sector and factor exposure from shares times price, on two beta windows
Compute realised, EWMA and implied volatility, run a vol-target rule, and build one-day parametric and historical VaR and expected shortfall with every step shown
Stress a book with a March 2020 correlation matrix and see why 2008 and 2020 broke VaR, then decompose variance to find the positions that actually carry the risk
Test a drawdown de-risking rule against 2008, 2020, 2022 and 2025 and measure what it costs when it fires too late and too early
Run a strategy through a written five-gate stack (sample size, out-of-sample replication, costs, overlap, cash) and price tail hedges (puts, VIX, trend) from their real track records
Set gross from Reg T and portfolio-margin arithmetic, install a kill switch and daily reconciliation, and write the daily, weekly and monthly risk report with its action triggers
